branded.why: One dairy's or company's product, sold in its shops but no part of a food culture beyond them.

about.text: A long-life UHT whipping cream with 38 % fat, sold by MBM, which needs no cold storage before opening. It is heated above 100 °C for 3 to 5 seconds.

sources.text: Its fat content, UHT treatment and shelf life, from this page.
